steps: Open the new restart starter in real Studio, inspect exact TXT in Chinese/English/Japanese at 390px, cancel without writes, then explicitly create and ordinarily save the new script and registration. No target_scene_id export exists.

Manage the existing level behavior through Studio: preview/cancel leaves all bytes untouched; explicit Save adds exactly one reviewed script reference to the behavior registration without changing its source.

Add a fresh binding to the player and select the newly linked script. Explicit Add missing supplies exactly action_name and state_values_json. Three-language 390px views show both defaults with no target parameter. Cancel discards the new binding and every local row without author writes.

Add a different fresh binding, explicitly Add missing, edit restart_game and the score0/health3/doorfalse JSON, inspect three-language narrow layouts, Check and Apply. Existing eleven binding byte ranges remain exact. Apply writes no author file; ordinary Save changes only the level behavior source.

Reload and reopen retain the explicit source, instance, two edited parameters and fresh identity. The ordinary four-scene build snapshot is valid, the script remains exact, and the retained author-final workspace matches saved UI bytes. Official sample and all guarded production source hashes stay unchanged.

restart-script-zh-CN.title: 新建脚本
restart-script-zh-CN.description: 等待 action_name（默认 ui_accept）的新按下，重新创建当前组装成员场景；无需目标场景。state_values_json 为最多16个标量键、4096 UTF-8字节的严格 JSON 初始值对象，只复位列出的共享状态。请求受理后原子应用，拒绝不改状态；进入时按住不会触发，需释放重按，界面已处理的输入不触发。只创建普通脚本，不创建输入映射。

restart-script-en.title: New script
restart-script-en.description: Wait for a fresh action_name press (ui_accept by default), then recreate the current assembly scene without a target ID. state_values_json is a strict JSON object of up to 16 scalar defaults and 4096 UTF-8 bytes; only listed shared values reset atomically. Refusal leaves state unchanged. Release and press again after entry; held or UI-consumed input does not restart. Creates an ordinary script, not an input map.

restart-script-ja.title: スクリプトを新規作成
restart-script-ja.description: action_name（既定値 ui_accept）が新しく押されたら、現在の構成メンバーのシーンを作り直します。対象 ID は不要です。state_values_json は16個以内のスカラー値、4096 UTF-8バイト以内の厳密なJSONオブジェクトで、指定した共有値だけを一括で初期化します。拒否時は状態を変えません。押したままやUIが処理した入力では再開始せず、離してから押し直す必要があります。通常のスクリプトだけを作成し、入力マップは作成しません。

limitations: Actual Chrome and Studio HTTP editor on a disposable reference-game copy with three explicitly recorded ordinary fixture choices. This is not from-blank project creation, installed Tauri or Android acceptance.

No restart TXT, registration, script relation, binding, or parameter is prepared by the harness. Each is created through ordinary Studio controls. The harness prepares only existing input mapping, menu progress default and audio looping before the UI run; original sample files remain untouched.

The fixture maps restart_game to R and Space, adds checkpoint progress to the menu initializer and loops the collection track for independent native teardown observations. No runtime source, generated project or native gameplay is claimed in this browser report.
Parameter discovery is an exact-source advisory provider. Explicit Add missing, local editing, Check, Apply and ordinary Save remain distinct operations. Cancel never writes the local draft.
